## bijection_verdict
**KB-BIJECTION RED.** This is one finding (B-1). It does not affect any scored value of task 1.

- **B-1: worked figures extend the OHI-line and cap-line computations to the fee-exempt tiers their own scope excludes.**
- Source: the rules of `select_ext_ohi_line_reprocessing` and `select_ext_cap_line_reprocessing` both close the domain: "the fee-exempt tiers (the Active Duty Family Member tiers) are outside this policy by design … for any other enrollee this policy settles nothing".
- Root cause: rendering additions (illustrations computing results the source never produces). Each named computation document now entails two contradicting domains.
- Affected documents and locations are quoted under kb_to_source. The primary ones are `reprocessed_outpatient_line_payment_figures_1b4d0d63` (all worked rows) and `cap_reprocessed_line_payment_computation_f0db06cb` (row 3). The factor-document hypotheticals listed there are the same nature.
- Everything else is lossless: three prerequisites, 21 factor ladders across the four policies, baselines, the retired surface and four tool contracts.
- First revision.

Hop marks from the blind answer: P0→P1, P1→P2 and P1→P3 are all state-derived, none pre-solved.

- Depended-on hubs and every factor document were reachable from record words ("reversed for other health insurance", "Inpatient Mental Health Authorization" + "exhausted", "TRICARE Prime", "quarterly" charge vs elected monthly, "individual").
- Computation documents carry no variation hints. Factor documents do not name the computation document or other factors, and none says which tier a customer falls on.

Observations (not verdicts):
- `installment_frequency_in_force_for_drafts_f5387371` hypothetical: "Quarterly charges have been made up to the quarter starting 2026-07-01, and the enrollment has since elected monthly installments: the frequency in force is quarterly". This illustrates the very situation of this customer (quarterly charging in force, monthly elected from January). It has different dates, is framed hypothetically and states the rule, so it is not counted as a tier statement.
- `covered_days_on_stays_reprocessed_for_other_insurance_565bed14` hypothetical: "authorization … approved for 7 days and since exhausted: 7 covered days". This partly coincides with the stay here (7 authorized, exhausted; 12 vs 8 billed).
